finalMessage:
I implemented the volume discount from SHOP-57. I couldn't read the Jira issue itself, so I worked from the `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT` item (revision 2) already in `trace.yaml`. All 38 tests pass, and `ostf check --base main` reports no errors (40 items, 115 valid links). I haven't committed anything or opened a PR.

**What changed**
- **`src/pricing.ts`:** the new `volumeDiscount(lines)` takes 5% off each cart line of 10 or more units, rounded down to the cent per line. `price()` has an optional trailing `volume` argument. It applies the volume discount first, then the discount code on what is left. The two together are capped at 50% of the subtotal.
- **`src/checkout.ts`:** `placeOrder` passes `volumeDiscount(cart.lines())` into `price()`.
- **`src/pricing.test.ts`:** two new tests cover the 10-unit threshold with rounding, and the discount ordering with the 50% cap.
- **`trace.yaml`:** I added `code` and `tests` links to the existing `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT` item and left its text alone.

**Check this:** the item doesn't say what the discount code applies to. I read it as the subtotal after the volume discount, with the 50% cap on both discounts together. If product meant the code to apply to the full subtotal, `price()` needs a one-line change.

**Impact that `ostf check` lists**
- **Items:** `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`, `R-TAX-RATE`, `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER` and `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`.
- **Tests to run:** all passing.
  - `checkout.test.ts`: `Checkout > places an order` and `Checkout > needs a valid session`.
  - `pricing.test.ts`: `price > taxes the subtotal after discounts`, `tax > rounds half up to the cent`, and the two new `volumeDiscount` tests.
- **Links added:** `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT` is now linked to `price` and `volumeDiscount`, and to the two new `volumeDiscount` tests.
- **Stamping:** `check` flagged three existing links as suspect (`placeOrder` to `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER` and `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`, and `price` to `R-TAX-RATE`). I rechecked them against the code, they still hold and their tests pass, so I stamped them. I stamped the four new links the same way.

No item became false, and I didn't touch any code marked risk-relevant.
